name: Tanka boats in the Praya Grande, Macau
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of a row of Tanka boats in the shallows close to the shore of the Praya Garnde ('Great Bay'), Macau; beyond is the church of S. Francisco.
